digest.component_or_area: Quality audit remediation (CI, docs, code structure)
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker crashes during test_opcert_service_app teardown due to load-dependent pytest-xdist race condition under host contention
User-facing assignee documentation example teaches an identity inconsistent with docs/config.md and not Jira-resolvable
structured_run.py and compact.py exceed 500 LOC threshold due to flat mixed-responsibility design; near-cap modules lack clear separation of concerns

Graph subsystem functions _find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked exhibit elevated cyclomatic complexity (CCN >15) from duplicated traversal infrastructure across multiple call sites
attest package contains untyped function definitions incompatible with mypy --disallow-untyped-defs ratchet requirement
Module splits and refactorings must preserve public import paths and not conflict with nine in-progress contended tickets to maintain non-overlapping file impact
